scope: Live video interview reliability and consented proctoring
status: Software changes implemented and automated checks passed. Real-device and cross-network media validation remains outstanding.

video: Separate tested peer-session lifecycle with collision-safe negotiation and serialized incoming signalling
ICE queued until its matching description arrives, including during connection restarts
Camera and microphone can be enabled or replaced after joining without leaving the room
Screen sharing uses a separate video track and keeps the webcam available for face monitoring
Explicit screen selection, stop-sharing control, browser stop-sharing handling, and expandable native video controls
Automatic bounded ICE recovery with renewed TURN credentials and a manual Reconnect video control
Authenticated participant-only camera, microphone and screen status updates
Reconnect restores the other participant's current media status; stale duplicate participant tabs are disconnected
Microphone-only recovery, local input-level meter, friendly permission/device failure messages and autoplay recovery button
Local tracks, screen capture and spoken-answer microphone capture stop when leaving or ending the session
proctoring: Existing explicit monitoring consent remains required; personal practice remains unmonitored
Browser focus, visibility, fullscreen, copy/paste and connection metadata
Camera/microphone availability and screen-share start/stop metadata without clipboard contents
Sustained no-face and multiple-face observations; coarse head orientation remains contextual and does not affect technical scores or integrity points
Camera outages reset face observations instead of becoming no-face events; hidden-tab time is excluded from sustained visual observation
Landmark-model failure falls back to face-presence detection; unavailable coverage is disclosed and can be retried
Metadata-only, interview-scoped tab storage supports retry after transient network failure and same-tab refresh
Batched idempotent event uploads prevent duplicate records after uncertain responses
HR-only live Monitoring panel with manual refresh and five-second updates while open
Existing report event timeline and human review remain separate from technical evaluation

validation.result: PASS: client TypeScript, Vite production build, server TypeScript, 11 test files, 116 tests
validation.testsUse: Mock browser media objects for peer logic, real local Socket.IO connections and an isolated temporary MongoDB for authorization/event delivery. No test fixtures were inserted into the normal recruitment database.
validation.windowsTestRunner: An initial fork-worker startup timed out. Isolated worker threads passed the complete suite and are now selected by vitest.config.ts on Windows.
validation.health: Database ping passed; API health and localhost website returned HTTP 200
validation.developmentModules: Room, live-call, monitoring and RoomMedia modules returned HTTP 200 from Vite
validation.models: BlazeFace and Face Landmarker returned HTTP 200 and matched the pinned SHA-256 checksums. MediaPipe WASM returned HTTP 200.
validation.buildWarning: Existing large Monaco editor chunk warning remains.

remainingVerification: Browser automation could not start because the Windows sandbox helper failed. Actual camera/audio playback, permissions UI, screen selection and changed room layout were not visually verified in this run.
TURN_URL and TURN_SECRET are not configured on this installation. UDP/TCP/TLS relay URLs and expiring per-user credentials are supported, but no live relay connection was tested.
The running application is localhost-only. A public HTTPS origin is needed for access from independent devices; no public deployment was created.
Test real Candidate and assigned HR devices on separate networks, including muted audio, screen sharing, temporary disconnect, reconnect and stopping all tracks at session end.
Face presence/multiple-person behavior still needs real-camera testing under different lighting. No extra-speaker identity model, calibrated gaze inference or trained integrity classifier was added.

operationalBounds.monitoringQueue: At most 200 metadata events in the current browser tab; overflow is disclosed with a coverage-gap event. Storage-blocked browsers use memory only. Closing the tab may lose unsent metadata.
operationalBounds.monitoringUploads: Batches contain at most 30 events. Recent in-call metadata can arrive for 10 minutes after completion; timestamps beyond the accepted session window are rejected.
operationalBounds.screenAndRecording: Screen sharing is live and explicitly selected. The existing optional recording captures the participant's camera/microphone, not the shared screen.
operationalBounds.evidence: Client monitoring is incomplete and can be inaccurate or manipulated. It never automatically selects or rejects a candidate.

manualCheckSequence: Use separate browser profiles or devices for the candidate and assigned HR so their login cookies do not replace each other.
Open the scheduled interview within its joining window. Check camera/microphone; candidate accepts the monitoring notice; both join.
Verify two-way video and speech, microphone mute/unmute, camera off/on, and enabling devices after joining.
Select Share screen, choose a harmless window, verify the remote view, then stop using the browser's sharing control.
Temporarily disconnect one participant and reconnect. Confirm that media recovers without losing unsaved code or typed answers.
In HR's Monitoring tab, check consented events, their timestamps, camera outages, screen-share changes and sustained face observations. Review context rather than treating an event as proof.
Finish the interview and confirm camera, microphone and screen indicators stop on both devices; review the report timeline.
